rows.note: Use 生產 as the all-purpose term for the activity of making goods from materials.

example.english: This factory’s manufacturing starts with raw materials and continues through to finished products.
example.traditional: 呢間工廠嘅生產由原材料開始，一直做到成品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 ge3 sang1 caan2 jau4 jyun4 coi4 liu2 hoi1 ci2 jat1 zik6 zou6 dou3 sing4 ban2

rows.note: Choose 製造 when emphasizing the actual fabrication or making of finished products rather than the broader production activity.

example.english: The manufacturing of this machine requires many precision parts.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅製造要用好多精密零件。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 ge3 zai3 zou6 jiu3 jung6 hou2 do1 zing1 mat6 ling4 gin6

rows.note: Use 製造業 specifically for manufacturing as an industry or economic sector.

example.english: Manufacturing has found it hard to recruit workers in recent years.
example.jyutping: zai3 zou6 jip6 gan6 nin4 ceng2 jan4 hou2 naan4
